status: draft for the owner's edit (the first Tier-2 slice, 2026-09-13)
artist_scope: full contract (Tier 2, the simple-cyclic class: geckolib_migration_design.md section 5)
character_sheet: A tiny ambient pest: a 1x1x8 body with two pairs of flat wings, buzzing through the air on its own flight goal. It is small enough to be missed and bites what it lands on. Read it as a nuisance in constant, fast flight.
size_notes: Drawn at x0.5 of the rig on a 32x32 sheet.

groups.name: wings
groups.plain: the four wings beat fast about the body's long axis, the right pair up while the left pair is down
groups.math: rightwing1.zRot = rightwing2.zRot = cos(ageInTicks * 3.0) * pi * 0.25; leftwing1.zRot = leftwing2.zRot = -(that)

behaviour: One rhythm runs at all times: the classic code has no rest pose and no gait scaling, so today's 'idle' is the same motion as the walk (the transcription's idle keys no bone and its one clip carries the bare name walk - contract section 2.1, a one-group species).
The beat runs whether it flies or sits; nothing else on the rig moves.

The default renderer poses it from the classic code; the GeckoLib candidate sits behind the dev switch (-Dorespawn.dev.geckolibRenderers) and your clips replace the shipped transcription file for file.

clips.name: walk
clips.note: the wing beat; keep the 45-degree flap

clips.name: idle
clips.note: optional: a slower beat when it has landed

clips.name: fly
clips.note: optional: falls back to walk (section 2.4); the beat is already the flight

clips.name: death
clips.note: PROVISIONAL: the vanilla death flip is open question 3
